learning_outcomes.text: Explains the basic principles of hydraulic and pneumatic systems (pressure, flow, force, etc.).
Defines the basic elements used in fluid power systems (pump, compressor, valve, actuator, etc.).
Compares the advantages and disadvantages of hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
Analyzes simple hydraulic and pneumatic circuits and explains their operating principles.
Designs hydraulic and pneumatic circuits and selects appropriate components.
Models and simulates hydraulic and pneumatic circuits using Fluidsim software.
Evaluates system performance (efficiency, energy losses, etc.).
Analyzes common faults in hydraulic and pneumatic systems and develops solutions.
Explains the basic operating principles of electro-hydraulic and electro-pneumatic systems.
Evaluates industrial applications of hydraulic and pneumatic systems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the course, general overview of fluid power systems, comparison of hydraulic and pneumatic systems
Basic concepts of fluid mechanics (pressure, flow, viscosity)
Hydraulic fluids and their properties, energy transmission
Hydraulic system components: pumps and actuators
Hydraulic valves: directional control, pressure and flow control valves
Introduction to pneumatic systems, air preparation and basic components
Introduction to electro-hydraulic and electro-pneumatic systems
System efficiency, energy losses, maintenance and fault analysis
General review, example applications and project/assignment evaluation
